summary: This study evaluated the diagnostic test accuracy and agreement of 15 combinations of ultrawide field scanning laser ophthalmoscopy (UWF SLO) images in myopic retinal changes (MRC) screening. UWF SLO images from 823 myopic patients (1,646 eyes) were analyzed by two retinal specialists, and the combinations of B + S + I, B + T + S + I, and B + S + N + I yielded the highest sensitivities (97.3-98.9%) and accuracy (97.7-98.8%) with high agreement (kappa = 0.968-0.980).
